literal.prompt: В каком году состоялся первый Парад Победы в Москве?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The Presidential Library dates the first Moscow Victory Parade to 24 June 1945 (L55-L57), supporting the asked event and correct year. USHMM dates Germany’s invasion of the USSR to 22 June 1941 (L100); the retained Presidential Library biography dates the Battle of Kursk to summer 1943 (L53). 1947 is two calendar years after the documented 1945 parade.
literalGroups.locator: Presidential Library L55-L57; USHMM L100; Zhukov biography L53.

literalGroups.literal: Первый Парад Победы прошёл в Москве 24 июня 1945 года. Его принимал маршал Георгий Жуков.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Presidential Library states that the parade took place on 24 June 1945 and identifies Marshal Georgy Zhukov as the parade commander (L55-L57).

literalGroups.literal: Первый Парад Победы прошёл на Красной площади 24 июня 1945 года.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The source gives the exact parade date, 24 June 1945, and places it in Moscow (L55-L57), adding the exact day and venue to the year-only question.

literalGroups.literal: В 1941 году началась Великая Отечественная война.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The page identifies the Great Patriotic War as 1941–1945 and USHMM records Germany’s attack on the Soviet Union on June 22, 1941 (L100), supporting the start-year statement.
literalGroups.locator: USHMM L100; Presidential Library page heading and L40-L42.

literalGroups.literal: 1947 год наступил через два года после окончания Великой Отечественной войны.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Presidential Library page identifies May 9, 1945 as Victory Day in the Great Patriotic War (L40-L42); 1947 is two years after 1945 by calendar arithmetic.
literalGroups.locator: Presidential Library L40-L42; calendar interval 1945 to 1947.
